title: Understanding Gradient Computations
text: Each paradigm involves a different number of gradient computations per epoch. Consider how many data points are processed in each paradigm and how often gradients are computed.

title: Batch Gradient Descent
text: In Batch Gradient Descent, the gradient is computed once per epoch using all data points. How many computations are there in total for $$5$$ epochs?

title: Batch Gradient Descent Calculations
text: Calculate the total number of gradient computations for Paradigm $$1$$ over $$5$$ epochs.

title: Mini-batch Gradient Descent
text: In Mini-batch Gradient Descent, the gradient is computed for each mini-batch. How many mini-batches are there per epoch?

title: Mini-batch Gradient Descent Calculations
text: Calculate the total number of gradient computations for Paradigm $$2$$ over $$5$$ epochs.

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent
text: In Stochastic Gradient Descent, the gradient is computed for each data point. How many computations are there per epoch?
